sources.title: [2511.16719] SAM 3: Segment Anything with Concepts - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We present Segment Anything Model (SAM) 3, a unified model that detects, segments, and tracks objects in images and videos based on concept prompts, which we define as either short noun phrases (e.g., "yellow school bus"), image exemplars, or a combination of both.
